name: FragField
summary: FragField is a low-poly multiplayer first-person shooter focused on large team battles. Two teams fight for control of capture zones on open maps, using class-based loadouts and a variety of vehicles including trucks, APCs, tanks and helicopters. Scoring is frag-based: kills, zone captures and team-support actions all contribute to the team total. The game is designed to run at high frame rates on low-end PCs. Formerly announced as Flick Frag.
